mat_chint_ddsu666._note_bind_2026_08_10: Batch 4 of #230. Four accessories where the shop stocked the sibling column and left this one. saj_ats1_datasheet_es.pdf prints S63 and T63 side by side under Monofasico / Trifasico, and de-linker sold only the three-phase T63 (1178), so a single-phase house - the ordinary German residential connection - had no transfer switch to buy and a backup design could not be completed. The SAJ Caro wallboxes AC011K-AE-35 (11 kW three-phase) and AC7000-AE-35 (7 kW single-phase) are in scope because res-ev-chargers exists with three published products, which supersedes the 2026-07-11 no-chargers note; both are cited to the real AC7000/AC011K datasheet #229 found, not the user manual we hold. DDSU666 is the single-phase counterpart of DTSU666 and is created as CHINT to match live 2281/2282, following the precedent 2281 already sets by branding it Chint while citing SAJ's datasheet. Prices are all arithmetic on de-linker's own published prices, recorded on each product: ATS1-S63-A 0.90 x 1178, the wallboxes at parity with the equivalent GoodWe HCA power class (420 / 501), DDSU666 0.70 x 2281.

mat_dehn_950530._note_bind_2026_08_10: #231, 2026-08-09 owner ruling: a package without these parts is not a package, so they must be buyable - but they must not appear as brands. Each of the nine is published with NO product_brand term and NO pa_brand attribute (pa_brand IS the shop's brand facet, so suppressing only the term would still have put DEHN and LAPP in the filter); the manufacturer name stays in the title and the spec rows because that is what physically ships and what an installer orders by. Specs are literals read from the manufacturer datasheets rather than registry lookups: the registry carries 2-3 rows for each of these, which is enough to size a string and not enough to sell a part. Placement follows the shop's own measured convention of one segment per accessory (of 213 published products, 77 sit in more than one category and every one of those is a parent/child pair; zero sit in both ci-accessories and res-accessories), so distribution protection went to ci-accessories and cables and connectors to res-accessories, with every page stating the part is used in both segments. Prices are a dated German-market check, not a derivation from de-linker's own ladder, because no anchor for an SPD, fuse, connector or cable existed here before today; two commercial facts are stated on the products rather than hidden - DEHN publishes list not street (current list 230,10 for 950 530, not the 156,30 in the 2020 catalogue the specs come from), and LAPP cable is copper-indexed against a basis of EUR 150/100 kg so the coil price is a snapshot reconfirmed at order.

mat_goodwe_gw50k_btc._note_bind_2026_08_10: Bound 2026-08-10 (task #230 batch 3). Six GoodWe models where the shop had taken one column of a MODEL row and left the other: goodwe_sec1000_datasheet_en.pdf line 29 prints SEC1000 beside SEC1000S and line 50 states in GoodWe's own words that the name covers an on-grid and a storage machine (the shop had only the storage one, 2400); DLK-GOODWE-SEC3000C_datasheet.pdf prints SEC3000 and SEC3000C separately (shop had only the C, 2409); goodwe_smart_meter_datasheet_en.pdf line 25 prints GM1000, GM1000D and GM3000, and the shop sold only the three-phase GM3000 so it had no single-phase GoodWe meter at all; goodwe_btc_flyer_with_lynxc_models.pdf line 33 gives GW50K-BTC its own Technical Data column while the shop sold only the two 07 models; goodwe_lynx_c_60kwh_en.pdf p2 prints the base cabinet and the extension in two columns and the shop sold only the base, 1953. Note the extension is mat_goodwe_gw60kwh_d_10_extension, not mat_goodwe_gw60kwh_d_10 as the #233 list said - the latter is already bound to 1953 and the SKU-collision guard caught it. Six GoodWe models where the shop had taken one column of a MODEL row and left the other: goodwe_sec1000_datasheet_en.pdf line 29 prints SEC1000 beside SEC1000S and line 50 states in GoodWe's own words that the name covers an on-grid and a storage machine (the shop had only the storage one, 2400); DLK-GOODWE-SEC3000C_datasheet.pdf prints SEC3000 and SEC3000C separately (shop had only the C, 2409); goodwe_smart_meter_datasheet_en.pdf line 25 prints GM1000, GM1000D and GM3000, and the shop sold only the three-phase GM3000 so it had no single-phase GoodWe meter at all; goodwe_btc_flyer_with_lynxc_models.pdf line 33 gives GW50K-BTC its own Technical Data column while the shop sold only the two 07 models; goodwe_lynx_c_60kwh_en.pdf p2 prints the base cabinet and the extension in two columns and the shop sold only the base, 1953. Note the extension is mat_goodwe_gw60kwh_d_10_extension, not mat_goodwe_gw60kwh_d_10 as the #233 list said - the latter is already bound to 1953 and the SKU-collision guard caught it. Every price derives from de-linker's own published GoodWe prices with the arithmetic recorded on the product.

relationships.constraint: Two GoodWe documents carry this pair: the Battery Compatibility Overview, ET (80–100 kW) column, and a signed Compatibility Statement of 2025-04-07 naming GW80K-ET-G10, GW99.99K-ET-G10 and GW100K-ET-G10 against GW61.4 to GW112.6-BAT-AC-G10. The Battery Compatibility Overview (p. 6) states that GW61.4-BAT-AC-G10 paired with ET (80–100 kW) cannot reach the inverter's full power output. GoodWe's BAT-C datasheet (p. 2) gives the GW61.4-BAT-AC-G10 an operating voltage range of 275.52 to 346.56 V (nominal 307.2 V); the ET 75–100 kW datasheet (p. 2) gives a battery voltage range of 300 to 800 V and a start-up voltage of 300 V.
relationships.constraint_de: Zwei GoodWe-Dokumente führen diese Kombination auf: die Batterie-Kompatibilitätsübersicht, Spalte ET (80–100 kW), und eine unterzeichnete Kompatibilitätserklärung vom 7. relationships.constraint: Two GoodWe documents carry this pair: the Battery Compatibility Overview, ET (80–100 kW) column, and a signed Compatibility Statement of 2025-04-07 naming GW80K-ET-G10, GW99.99K-ET-G10 and GW100K-ET-G10 against GW61.4 to GW112.6-BAT-AC-G10. The Battery Compatibility Overview (p. 6) states that GW61.4-BAT-AC-G10 paired with ET (80–100 kW) cannot reach the inverter's full power output. GoodWe's BAT-C datasheet (p. 2) gives the GW61.4-BAT-AC-G10 an operating voltage range of 275.52 to 346.56 V (nominal 307.2 V); the ET 75–100 kW datasheet (p. 2) gives a battery voltage range of 300 to 800 V and a start-up voltage of 300 V.
relationships.constraint_de: Zwei GoodWe-Dokumente führen diese Kombination auf: die Batterie-Kompatibilitätsübersicht, Spalte ET (80–100 kW), und eine unterzeichnete Kompatibilitätserklärung vom 7. April 2025, die GW80K-ET-G10, GW99.99K-ET-G10 und GW100K-ET-G10 für GW61.4 bis GW112.6-BAT-AC-G10 nennt. Laut der Batterie-Kompatibilitätsübersicht von GoodWe (S. 6) erreicht GW61.4-BAT-AC-G10 an ET (80–100 kW) nicht die volle Wechselrichterleistung. Das BAT-C-Datenblatt von GoodWe (S. 2) gibt für GW61.4-BAT-AC-G10 einen Betriebsspannungsbereich von 275,52 bis 346,56 V an (Nennspannung 307,2 V); das Datenblatt des ET 75–100 kW (S. 2) nennt einen Batteriespannungsbereich von 300 bis 800 V und eine Startspannung von 300 V.

The Battery Compatibility Overview (p. 6) states that GW61.4-BAT-AC-G10 paired with ET (80–100 kW) cannot reach the inverter's full power output. GoodWe's BAT-C datasheet (p. 2) gives the GW61.4-BAT-AC-G10 an operating voltage range of 275.52 to 346.56 V (nominal 307.2 V); the ET 75–100 kW datasheet (p. 2) gives a battery voltage range of 300 to 800 V and a start-up voltage of 300 V.
relationships.constraint_de: Zwei GoodWe-Dokumente führen diese Kombination auf: die Batterie-Kompatibilitätsübersicht, Spalte ET (80–100 kW), und eine unterzeichnete Kompatibilitätserklärung vom 7. April 2025, die GW80K-ET-G10, GW99.99K-ET-G10 und GW100K-ET-G10 für GW61.4 bis GW112.6-BAT-AC-G10 nennt. Laut der Batterie-Kompatibilitätsübersicht von GoodWe (S. 6) erreicht GW61.4-BAT-AC-G10 an ET (80–100 kW) nicht die volle Wechselrichterleistung. Das BAT-C-Datenblatt von GoodWe (S. 2) gibt für GW61.4-BAT-AC-G10 einen Betriebsspannungsbereich von 275,52 bis 346,56 V an (Nennspannung 307,2 V); das Datenblatt des ET 75–100 kW (S. 2) nennt einen Batteriespannungsbereich von 300 bis 800 V und eine Startspannung von 300 V.

mat_lapp_1023601._note_bind_2026_08_10: #231, 2026-08-09 owner ruling: a package without these parts is not a package, so they must be buyable - but they must not appear as brands. Each of the nine is published with NO product_brand term and NO pa_brand attribute (pa_brand IS the shop's brand facet, so suppressing only the term would still have put DEHN and LAPP in the filter); the manufacturer name stays in the title and the spec rows because that is what physically ships and what an installer orders by. Specs are literals read from the manufacturer datasheets rather than registry lookups: the registry carries 2-3 rows for each of these, which is enough to size a string and not enough to sell a part. Placement follows the shop's own measured convention of one segment per accessory (of 213 published products, 77 sit in more than one category and every one of those is a parent/child pair; zero sit in both ci-accessories and res-accessories), so distribution protection went to ci-accessories and cables and connectors to res-accessories, with every page stating the part is used in both segments. Prices are a dated German-market check, not a derivation from de-linker's own ladder, because no anchor for an SPD, fuse, connector or cable existed here before today; two commercial facts are stated on the products rather than hidden - DEHN publishes list not street (current list 230,10 for 950 530, not the 156,30 in the 2020 catalogue the specs come from), and LAPP cable is copper-indexed against a basis of EUR 150/100 kg so the coil price is a snapshot reconfirmed at order.

mat_pylontech_powercube_h1._note_bind_2026_08_10: Batch 5 of #230. The shop sold 34 Pylontech products and no PowerCube of any kind while the design engine was free to recommend all of them. A rack is its modules plus its BMS, so module availability IS system availability - the ruling that put X1/X2/H1/H2 back on the offer on 2026-08-10 and that brings M2A-180 (19 x HM2A180) with them; M1C, M3A-100 and M3A-180 stay delisted as integrated cabinets with no EU seller. The specifications of all five were replaced first from Pylontech's own installation manuals (tier 1, self-hosted as media 4120/4121/4122) because the previous values came from two tier-4 documents that print one configuration per model: that had left H1 capped at 15 modules and H2 at 12, which are the manual's rack-transition points and not the ceilings (both reach 18, and a reseller's 63.9 kWh H2 listing independently confirms it), cycle life understated at 3,500 against 5,000, max discharge current 100 A on three models read off the controller's model number, X2's rack height 1380 instead of 2130 mm, and every weight a single figure matching no configuration of the manual's own formula. Each product is priced at a NAMED configuration in its title because Pylontech uses one model name for the whole range; the single anchor is a German reseller's complete 17.75 kWh X2 at EUR 5,499.90, flagged single_source_derived on every product.
mat_pylontech_powercube_h1._note_channel_2026_08_10: Supply finding 2026-08-10 (task #230): no EU system-level source. No sellable EU listing. Segen carries H1 only as reseller documents (manuals, certificates, commercial presentation), not as a product.

relationships.constraint: SAJ's Configuration Instructions V1.0 (Section 2) give the H2 series system as H2 + BC2 + BU2. SAJ's B2 datasheet names B2-5.0 to B2-25.0 as one to five BU2-5.0 modules with one BC2-HV1 control module, and SAJ's B2 manual (V1.2, PDF p5) says the B2 can only be used as a set with SAJ's H2 high voltage series storage inverter. The listing does not cover the one-module B2-5.0, whose operating voltage lies below the H2 T3's battery voltage range. SAJ's B2 datasheet gives 179.2 to 230.4 V for the two-module B2-10.0; the H2 T3 manual's battery voltage range begins at 180 V.

relationships.constraint: SAJ's Configuration Instructions V1.0 (Section 2) give the H2 series system as H2 + BC2 + BU2. SAJ's B2 datasheet names B2-5.0 to B2-25.0 as one to five BU2-5.0 modules with one BC2-HV1 control module, and SAJ's B2 manual (V1.2, PDF p5) says the B2 can only be used as a set with SAJ's H2 high voltage series storage inverter. The listing does not cover the one-module B2-5.0, whose operating voltage lies below the H2 T3's battery voltage range. SAJ's B2 datasheet gives 179.2 to 230.4 V for the two-module B2-10.0; the H2 T3 manual's battery voltage range begins at 180 V.
relationships.constraint_de: Die SAJ-Konfigurationsanleitung V1.0 (Abschnitt 2) gibt das System der H2-Serie als H2 + BC2 + BU2 an. Das SAJ-Datenblatt der B2 nennt B2-5.0 bis B2-25.0 als ein bis fünf BU2-5.0-Module mit einem Steuermodul BC2-HV1, und das SAJ-Handbuch der B2 (V1.2, PDF-S. 5) gibt an, dass die B2 nur im Verbund mit dem Hochvolt-Speicherwechselrichter der SAJ-H2-Serie eingesetzt werden kann. Die Listung umfasst die B2-5.0 mit einem Modul nicht; ihre Betriebsspannung liegt unter dem Batteriespannungsbereich des H2 T3. Das SAJ-Datenblatt der B2 nennt für die B2-10.0 mit zwei Modulen 179,2 bis 230,4 V; der Batteriespannungsbereich im H2-T3-Handbuch beginnt bei 180 V.

mat_saj_h2_15k_t2._note_not_supplied_2026_08_10: Not supplied by de-linker, 2026-08-10 (task #230). SAJ's T-suffix is the MPP tracker count, not a market or power variant: saj_h2_10_30k_datasheet_eu_en.pdf line 13 (No. of MPPT) reads 3/2/3/2/3 against the ten columns of the line-1 MODEL row, and line 14 confirms it with 2/2/2 strings for T3 against 2/2 for T2. H2-15K-T2 is therefore the same 15 kW machine as H2-15K-T3 with one fewer tracker, and every other spec row is identical. de-linker sells H2-15K-T3 as product 2063, so nothing is unbuyable: a request for 15 kW three-phase is served by the three-tracker unit, which is strictly more flexible across roof orientations. SAJ's own family copy on line 20 positions the H2 as a three-tracker product. Not created because there is no price source for the one-tracker differential and listing a same-power, strictly-inferior twin beside the stocked unit is a customer-confusion trap rather than a capability gap. If a project specifically wants the two-tracker variant it goes on the quote.

mat_staubli_32_0316p0001._note_bind_2026_08_10: #231, 2026-08-09 owner ruling: a package without these parts is not a package, so they must be buyable - but they must not appear as brands. Each of the nine is published with NO product_brand term and NO pa_brand attribute (pa_brand IS the shop's brand facet, so suppressing only the term would still have put DEHN and LAPP in the filter); the manufacturer name stays in the title and the spec rows because that is what physically ships and what an installer orders by. Specs are literals read from the manufacturer datasheets rather than registry lookups: the registry carries 2-3 rows for each of these, which is enough to size a string and not enough to sell a part. Placement follows the shop's own measured convention of one segment per accessory (of 213 published products, 77 sit in more than one category and every one of those is a parent/child pair; zero sit in both ci-accessories and res-accessories), so distribution protection went to ci-accessories and cables and connectors to res-accessories, with every page stating the part is used in both segments. Prices are a dated German-market check, not a derivation from de-linker's own ladder, because no anchor for an SPD, fuse, connector or cable existed here before today; two commercial facts are stated on the products rather than hidden - DEHN publishes list not street (current list 230,10 for 950 530, not the 156,30 in the 2020 catalogue the specs come from), and LAPP cable is copper-indexed against a basis of EUR 150/100 kg so the coil price is a snapshot reconfirmed at order.

mat_trina_solar_tsm_460neg9r_28._note_not_supplied_2026_08_10: 2026-08-10 owner ruling: de-linker does not sell PV modules. Product 4137 was created and trashed the same day, and the root category pv-modules was deleted. The record stays because a stored-energy design still has to size strings against a real module, and because the shop supplies everything around the panel - PV string cable, MC4 EVO2 and TS4 connectors, string fuses and holders, DC surge arresters. Not supplied means the customer procures the module; it does not mean this module is wrong for the job. It is the current model of Trina's Vertex S+ NEG9R.28 line, specified to Trina's own datasheet version TSM_EN_2024_C.
